text:
lina.sales: Quick ask 10am POC: NovaHealth needs an IAM evidence bundle for their vendor review. They want SAML metadata, a short MFA enforcement statement, a role mapping sample, and service-account rules. Can we assemble by lunch?

sam.security: Short checklist: metadata.xml, redacted-saml-response, MFA blurb, RBAC CSV, API-key/service-account guidance, and audit retention statement. Keep it consumable.

igor.eng: I'll export metadata.xml and a sanitized saml-response.txt. Will include example attribute names: email, groups, sub.

maya.devx: For the mapping show default "org:viewer" as least-privilege and a sample mapping table. Keep CSV headings simple.

trent.solutions: I'll prepare a CSV: customer_group,redwood_role,notes. Example: "platform,editor,can create routes". Also add note about rotatable scoped keys for service accounts.

lina.sales: Sam 1: can you draft the MFA line and assertion lifetime note?

sam.security: MFA blurb: "MFA is required for all human users. For SSO we enforce MFA at the IdP (we recommend Okta/Azure AD); direct console logins require MFA via Redwood. Authentication and MFA events are logged and retained 365 days. Assertions: NotOnOrAfter validity <= 5 minutes; we enforce Recipient/Audience and InResponseTo checks."

igor.eng: Snippet to include:
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name=\"email\">
    <saml:AttributeValue>user@nova.local</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
  <saml:Attribute Name=\"groups\">
    <saml:AttributeValue>nova-admins</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>

file-bot: Reminder: upload quota approaching 90%. Attach small files to the ticket if needed.

maya.devx: I'll quick-review once uploaded. If Nova needs a signed attestation escalate to Sam.

lina.sales: Thanks team 12: I'll notify Nova and aim to deliver before 13:00.
